Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (Runner's Knee)
description: Pain around/behind the kneecap, often from overuse or poor kneecap tracking.

name: Osteoarthritis of the Knee
description: Age-related wear of the joint cartilage, causing stiffness and pain, especially with activity.

name: Meniscus Tear
description: Damage to the cartilage cushioning the knee joint, often from twisting movements.

name: ACL (Anterior Cruciate Ligament) Sprain/Tear
description: Injury to a key stabilizing ligament, common in sudden stops or direction changes.

name: MCL (Medial Collateral Ligament) Sprain
description: Strain on the inner knee ligament, often from a sideways impact or stress.

name: Patellar Tendinitis (Jumper's Knee)
description: Inflammation of the tendon connecting the kneecap to the shinbone, common in jumping-heavy activity.

name: IT Band Syndrome (Iliotibial Band Syndrome)
description: Tightness/friction of the band running along the outer thigh to the knee, causing outer knee pain.

name: Bursitis of the Knee
description: Inflammation of the fluid-filled sac cushioning the knee joint.

name: Chondromalacia Patella
description: Softening/breakdown of cartilage under the kneecap, causing a grinding or aching sensation.

name: PCL (Posterior Cruciate Ligament) Sprain
description: Injury to the ligament stabilizing backward knee movement, often from a direct blow to the front of the knee.

name: Knee Pain from Weak Quadriceps
description: Reduced muscle support around the joint leading to instability and strain.

name: Patellar Dislocation/Subluxation
description: The kneecap partially or fully shifts out of its normal groove.

name: Gout in the Knee
description: Sudden, sharp joint pain and swelling from uric acid crystal buildup.

name: Rheumatoid Arthritis of the Knee
description: An autoimmune condition causing joint inflammation, stiffness, and swelling.

name: Referred Knee Pain from Hip Issues
description: Hip joint problems that present as knee discomfort due to shared nerve pathways.

name: Knee Pain from Poor Footwear/Overpronation
description: Improper foot alignment placing uneven stress on the knee joint.

name: Postural Knee Strain from Prolonged Standing
description: Common in retail/service roles, where standing for long hours fatigues knee-supporting muscles.

name: Knee Stiffness from Prolonged Sitting
description: Reduced knee mobility and stiffness from extended sedentary periods, common with desk jobs.
